definitions.explanation: A type of sushi roll made with a full sheet of nori seaweed and filled with multiple ingredients, resulting in a thick, round cross-section. A staple of home-made sushi and bento boxes.

examples.japanese: {太巻|ふとま}きを{作|つく}った。
{節分|せつぶん}には{太巻|ふとま}きを{丸|まる}かぶりする{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: There is a custom of eating a whole thick sushi roll on Setsubun.

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}に{太巻|ふとま}きを{切|き}って{入|い}れると、{断面|だんめん}がきれいで{喜|よろこ}ばれる。
examples.english: If you slice thick sushi rolls and put them in a bento, the colorful cross-section looks nice and people love it.

notes:
USAGE:
{太巻|ふとま}き is contrasted with {細巻|ほそま}き (thin roll), which uses half a sheet of nori and a single filling. {太巻|ふとま}き typically contains multiple ingredients such as egg, cucumber, kanpyo, and fish.

CULTURAL NOTE:
During {節分|せつぶん} (February 3), it is customary in many parts of Japan to eat a whole {太巻|ふとま}き called {恵方巻|えほうまき} while facing the lucky direction of the year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太巻|ふとま}きを{巻|ま}く: to roll a thick sushi roll
- {太巻|ふとま}き{寿司|ずし}: thick-rolled sushi

FORMS:
{太|ふと} (thick) + {巻|ま}き (roll).
